E1.Info: Ten years ago, gates that connected our world to another dimension began to appear, leading to the rise of hunters who would traverse these gates to fight the magic beasts within. Sung Jin-woo, E-Rank hunter, is the weakest of them all.
E1.Subtitle: unavailable
E1.Title: I'm Used to It

E2.Info: Jin-woo and his party appear to have cleared a low-level dungeon, when a hidden path to an unfamiliar temple is revealed. There they encounter a set of commandments and a group of monsters that cause them absolute despair.
E2.Subtitle: unavailable
E2.Title: If I Had One More Chance

E3.Info: Jin-woo remains behind in the temple dungeon to save his few surviving party members, and with a swing from the god statue's blade, his life comes to an end, or so it seems, before he wakes up in a hospital bed.
E3.Subtitle: unavailable
E3.Title: It's Like a Game

E4.Info: Having entered the instance dungeon located inside the subway, Jin-woo levels up time and time again by fighting waves of magic beasts. As he gradually makes his way forward, he finds a long stairway
E4.Subtitle: unavailable
E4.Title: I've Gotta Get Stronger

E5.Info: Jin-woo joins Hwang Dong-suk's party for a C-Rank dungeon. With temporary member Yoo Jin-ho, they defeat beasts. Jin-woo worries about no healer.
E5.Subtitle: unavailable
E5.Title: A Pretty Good Deal

E6.Info: While the C-Rank dungeon raid by Jin-woo and the others seems to be progressing well, the moment they step into an area covered in mana stones with a sleeping dungeon boss, things take a wrong turn.
E6.Subtitle: unavailable
E6.Title: The Real Hunt Begins

E7.Info: As Jin-woo continues his training, he completes a daily quest one day by doing more than the quest requires, and a key that leads to a certain item appears in front of him.
E7.Subtitle: unavailable
E7.Title: Let's See How Far I Can Go

E8.Info: Jin-woo answers a Hunter's Association request to take part in the raid of a D-Rank dungeon, where he encounters a few familiar faces.
E8.Subtitle: unavailable
E8.Title: This Is Frustrating

E9.Info: At the D-Rank raid, Jin-woo is reunited with four of the Cartenon Temple survivors. Together, they explore the dungeon with Kang Tae-shik and his men. After splitting up, they hear a scream, and then.
E9.Subtitle: unavailable
E9.Title: You've Been Hiding Your Skills

E10.Info: Jin-woo survives tragedy once again, but Woo Jin-chul warns him that Hwang Dong-soo, an S-Rank hunter, may be after his life. Determined to grow stronger, he and Jin-ho raid a succession of C-Rank dungeons, but they attract attention.
E10.Subtitle: unavailable
E10.Title: What Is This, a Picnic?

E11.Info: A surprise "job-change quest" appears for Jin-woo. Seeking strength, he accepts and enters, confronting endless foes. The final challenge, a knight, stirs memories of the Cartenon Temple.
E11.Subtitle: unavailable
E11.Title: A Knight Who Defends an Empty Throne

E12.Info: Drained from endless battle, Jin-woo sees a phantom of his past self. To overcome his own past as the Weakest Hunter of All Mankind, he struggles to find a way to clear the job-change quest.
E12.Subtitle: unavailable
E12.Title: Arise

E1.Info: At Jinah's school meeting, Jinwoo is asked to speak with her classmate Han Song-yi, who has started working as a hunter. To show her the dangerous reality of the profession, he takes her to observe a White Tiger.
E1.Subtitle: unavailable
E1.Title: You Aren't E-Rank, Are You?

E2.Info: Trapped within a red gate, Jinwoo encounters a savage pack of ice elves who not only threaten his life but also taunt him about his humanity, forcing him into a deadly confrontation.
E2.Subtitle: unavailable
E2.Title: I Suppose You Aren't Aware

E3.Info: Jinwoo, now more powerful after conquering 19 dungeons, returns to the treacherous S-Rank Demon's Castle. His mission to obtain rare ingredients for the Elixir of Life, a crucial step in his quest to save his ailing mother.
E3.Subtitle: unavailable
E3.Title: Still a Long Way to Go

E4.Info: Jinwoo realizes that he'll need to become even stronger in order to clear the Demon's Castle and decides to have his hunter rank reassessed.
E4.Subtitle: unavailable
E4.Title: I Need to Stop Faking

E5.Info: Before attempting to finish the Demon's Castle, Jinwoo decides to earn some money to help prepare.
E5.Subtitle: unavailable
E5.Title: This Is What We're Trained to Do

E6.Info: Jinwoo decides to help hunters guild strike team who is confronting the high orc Shaman Kargalgan which results in the epic fight.
E6.Subtitle: unavailable
E6.Title: Don't Look Down on My Guys

E7.Info: Jinwoo officially becomes an S-Rank hunter, allowing him to finalize his preparations for the Demon's Castle.
E7.Subtitle: unavailable
E7.Title: The 10th S-Rank Hunter

E8.Info: Seeking the remaining ingredient for the Elixir of Life, Jinwoo continues his conquest of the Demon's Castle.
E8.Subtitle: unavailable
E8.Title: Looking Up Was Tiring Me Out

E9.Info: Jinwoo tries to cure his mother with the Elixir of Life while preparations for the 4th Jeju Island Raid begin.
E9.Subtitle: unavailable
E9.Title: It Was All Worth It

E10.Info: S-Rank hunters spar in preparation for the Jeju Island raid, honing their skills for the imminent battle against powerful magic beasts.
E10.Subtitle: unavailable
E10.Title: We Need a Hero

E11.Info: As the S-rank hunters continue fighting, they're confronted by a new magic beast resembling a humanoid ant.
E11.Subtitle: unavailable
E11.Title: It's Going to Get Even More Intense

E12.Info: Jinwoo arrives at Jeju Island to save the S-Rank hunters, but to do that he'll have to face the Ant King.
E12.Subtitle: unavailable
E12.Title: Are You the King of Humans

E13.Info: After no shortage of hardship, the 4th Jeju Island raid comes to a close. But for Jinwoo, the hunt never ends.
E13.Subtitle: unavailable
E13.Title: On to the Next Target
